rules.applies_when: user intent is converted into engineering work
actions: separate requirement assumption candidate and unknown
define measurable acceptance and failure behavior
acceptance: each mandatory requirement has unambiguous subject condition and verifiable outcome
unknown numeric limit is not invented
rules.failure_policy: block dependent design decision and request/derive only missing authoritative input

rules.applies_when: a requirement is implemented or claimed complete
actions: check orphan requirements and unapproved implementation
acceptance: every mandatory requirement links to implementation and current verification
every safety-relevant implementation links back to approved requirement
orphan count is zero or explicitly dispositioned

rules.applies_when: responsibility or data/control flow spans components
actions: analyze coupling fault propagation and recovery
acceptance: every interface has owner version units timing and error semantics
no critical responsibility is duplicated or unowned
fault containment and recovery are defined
rules.failure_policy: hold cross-domain implementation on unresolved interface

acceptance: allocations plus overhead and required margin do not exceed verified limit
rules.failure_policy: block capacity/performance claim and identify missing or exceeded contributor

acceptance: every high risk has implemented and verified mitigation
AI does not self-accept residual risk
rules.failure_policy: block affected gate or physical action

actions: identify software hardware PCB test manufacturing field impacts
acceptance: rollback or non-reversibility is documented and approved
rules.failure_policy: keep old baseline effective until change gate passes
